Question

Let’s say you want to make a spirolateral.

If the turn angle is \(\theta=72^{\circ}\) and the maximum segment length is \(n=13\), then which spirolateral is created?

You can use this tool:

https://artockthedino.github.io/pbl/spirolateral/spirolateral_generator.html


Answerlist

  • A
  • B
  • C
  • D
  • E
  • F
  • G
  • H

Solution

The correct answer is F.

Below I’ve listed the parameters used to generate all patterns:

  • A:
    • Turn angle = 36
    • Count max = 16

  • B:
    • Turn angle = 36
    • Count max = 6

  • C:
    • Turn angle = 155
    • Count max = 18

  • D:
    • Turn angle = 40
    • Count max = 6

  • E:
    • Turn angle = 84
    • Count max = 12

  • F:
    • Turn angle = 72
    • Count max = 13

  • G:
    • Turn angle = 20
    • Count max = 10

  • H:
    • Turn angle = 18
    • Count max = 15
